$comment: TEMPLATE. Every `record` below is SYNTHETIC and must stay synthetic: this file is committed,
so a real composerData blob pasted in here publishes somebody's prompts, file paths and
repository names. The capture procedure is: run the sanitizer on a real Cursor install, fill
`observed` for each row from what it reports, and paste only the SHAPE back — key spelling,
field names, field types, and whether a field was present. Never a value.
Task 08-C is blocked on this matrix plus a backend-approved partial-snapshot contract. Until
both exist, lib/history-index.mjs enumerates and counts and HISTORY_UPLOAD_ENABLED stays false.

rows.question: What exactly is the composerData key, and is the id after the colon the stable conversation id the hooks see?
Does the id in the key equal the conversation_id a hook payload carries for the same conversation?
Which fields carry creation and last-activity time, in what unit, and are they ever absent?
What does a record with no creation time look like? (A missing started_at blocks DB-only upload; it must never fall back to now.)
Which field holds the title, and how long can it get? (Capped at 500 on the wire.)
Is there any workspace/folder attribution on the record, and is it a path or an id?
A conversation fully covered by the seat: is usageData absent, or present and empty?
A conversation with usage-priced requests: the per-model shape, and which amount/cents spelling is in use.
usageData present but an empty object — does that mean nothing priced, or not yet written?
Any record where usageData is not an object of objects (array, string, null) — a format move in progress.
Does usageData only ever grow within one conversation, and does it reset on anything (plan change, month roll)?
Is there ANY authoritative total token count on the record? (Expected: no. A no is the finding.)
Is there any session duration on the record? (Expected: no.)
With Cursor running, does the read-only open fail and the snapshot copy succeed? Both must yield `unavailable`, never zero, when they do not.
Which key/value tables exist on this build? A build with none of the known ones must read as unavailable.
